sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 75 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: The original inner border crosses open pavement on the western straight and the outer border contains a centimetre-scale self-crossing. Native licensed imagery and the complete estimate overlay were reviewed. The independently image-estimated main layout follows exactly the same 124-node closed source cycle, starting four nodes earlier. Re-estimate this unchanged target cycle in its own order using the same pinned image; do not copy or fit a different route. Limits at paved junctions and between observations remain unverified estimates.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
